text:
mira: Heads-up: CI runner produced different 'false_positive_rate' numbers between the export payload and the dashboard compare view. Quick thread to align.
aj: Saw that on my smoke run. looks like binning changed after quantize step? :thinking_face:
devin: Can you paste the query? I can check ingest timestamps.
mira: Query from exporter: ```SELECT bin, count(*) AS n, avg(score>0.5) as fpr FROM eval_runs WHERE model='gpt-mini-q' AND run_id='2026-03-smoke-42' GROUP BY bin;``` but dashboard uses percentiles instead of fixed bins — not directly comparable.
katie: oh nice, that's probably it. Dashboard's diff panel aggregates over 'score_percentile' → buckets are adaptive. We recently changed bucket config in frontend from 50 uniform to 20 log buckets.
aj: So mismatch source: exporter uses legacy fixed buckets saved in runner payload, dashboard re-buckets on the fly. Need a determinism guarantee so reported deltas aren't misleading.
sanjay: Suggested fix: add a `buckets_v` metadata field to runner export and store the explicit bucket edges verbatim. Then dashboard will prefer stored edges and will early-warn if it has to re-bucket.
devin: I can wire this in CI: runner smoke job will assert exporter.buckets_v == dashboard.expected_buckets for stable runs. Failing job will upload the sample payload to /tmp/smoke-artifacts for debug and link it in the job log.
mira: SGTM. Also let's add a light UI hint: "Results re-bucketed — not comparable to stored metrics" so PMs/owners don't misread diffs.
eval-bot: eval-bot: new commit 4f2c7 added buckets metadata to payload (https://git.redwood/reeval/commit/4f2c7) — pipeline smoke triggered.
katie: :thumbsup: I'll update frontend to honor bucket edges when present and render the hint. ETA EOD.
aj: I'll follow up with a short playbook in eng-ml/wiki explaining how to include stable buckets in custom evals and what to do if re-bucketing occurs.
mira: Thanks all — assigning devin to the CI patch, katie for frontend, sanjay for runner exporter. Moving to PRs. mark as resolved when PRs merged :white_check_mark:
